title: TripAdvisor Intelligence Pro Input
description: Pull TripAdvisor with rich enrichment. Drop in a city name and place type, or paste any TripAdvisor URL (Tourism, Hotel_Review, Restaurant_Review, Attraction_Review, VacationRentalReview, AttractionProductReview). Each property ships as one dataset row.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: City, neighborhood, or country name. The actor resolves it to a TripAdvisor geo ID and pulls the matching place lists. Leave blank if you only want to scrape startUrls.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Mix any of: Tourism (city overview), Hotel_Review, Restaurant_Review, Attraction_Review, VacationRentalReview, AttractionProductReview, or list URLs (Hotels-, Restaurants-, Attractions-).

maxResults.title: Max results per search query / start URL
maxResults.description: Hard cap on properties returned per search or list URL. 0 means everything TripAdvisor exposes.

placeTypes.title: Place types to include
placeTypes.description: Which TripAdvisor sections to crawl when scraping by search query. Direct URLs always honor their type.

includeReviewTags.title: Include review tags
includeReviewTags.description: Pull the auto generated review tags (e.g. great location, romantic, family friendly). Used by travelers to filter reviews.

includeNearbyResults.title: Include nearby results
includeNearbyResults.description: Also pull the nearby section that TripAdvisor shows on every detail page (10 to 20 nearby properties).

extractAmenities.title: Extract amenities and features
extractAmenities.description: Hotels, vacation rentals, and attractions ship every listed amenity (pool, free Wi-Fi, accessibility, family rooms).

extractAwards.title: Extract awards
extractAwards.description: Travelers' Choice, Certificate of Excellence, Best of the Best, and category awards.

extractRatingBreakdown.title: Extract rating breakdown
extractRatingBreakdown.description: Per category ratings (cleanliness, service, value, location, rooms, sleep) for hotels, plus food / service / value / atmosphere for restaurants.

extractRecentReviewSnippets.title: Extract recent review snippets
extractRecentReviewSnippets.description: Capture the first three review snippets visible on the detail page. Useful for sentiment summaries without pulling every review.

extractContact.title: Extract contact details
extractContact.description: Phone number, website URL, structured address, and coordinates when present.

extractHoursAndPricing.title: Extract hours and pricing
extractHoursAndPricing.description: Operating hours, price tier, lowest rate (hotels and vacation rentals), tour duration and price, and meal types served.

extractPhotos.title: Extract photo URLs
extractPhotos.description: Pull the gallery photo URLs in original resolution.

maxPhotosPerProperty.title: Max photos per property
maxPhotosPerProperty.description: Cap on photo URLs returned per row. Set 0 for all.

checkInDate.title: Check in date (hotels and vacation rentals)
checkInDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Drives availability and pricing for hotels and vacation rentals. Leave blank for default rate.

checkOutDate.title: Check out date (hotels and vacation rentals)
checkOutDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Required when checkInDate is set.

guests.title: Guests (hotels and vacation rentals)
guests.description: Number of adult guests. Affects pricing.

minRating.title: Minimum rating (filter)
minRating.description: Drop properties rated below this number of stars (1.0 to 5.0). 0 means no filter.

language.title: Language
language.description: TripAdvisor interface and review language. Affects which reviews are surfaced and how metadata reads.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency for hotel rates, vacation rental rates, and tour pricing.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip property IDs already pushed in previous runs. Turn off to refresh stale rows. Off by default so a repeated query returns its full result set. Turn it on to poll for new items only.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of pages processed in parallel. Three to five is safe. Higher triggers Cloudflare challenges.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for TripAdvisor at meaningful volume.
